title: Reseed overwrites account snapshot stalk per token, destroying multi-token holders' weight

location.code_snippet:
// set stalk for account.
            s.accts[deposits.accounts].stalk = accountStalk;

description: ReseedSilo.init() re-seeds the L2 silo by calling reseedSiloDeposit() once per whitelisted token (BEAN, BEAN:ETH, BEAN:wstETH, BEAN:3CRV, urBEAN, urBEAN:LP). Inside reseedSiloDeposit, after summing an account's grown+base stalk for THAT token into the local `accountStalk`, it writes `s.accts[deposits.accounts].stalk = accountStalk;` (ReseedSilo.sol#164) using a plain assignment (`=`) rather than an accumulating add (`+=`). `s.accts[account].stalk` is the account's checkpointed Stalk weight. For any farmer who held deposits in more than one of the six tokens on L1 (the common case for any LP+BEAN depositor), each subsequent reseedSiloDeposit call OVERWRITES the stalk written by the previous token. After init() completes, the account's stalk reflects ONLY the last token processed in init() (urBEAN:LP deposits), and all stalk from BEAN and the LP tokens is silently discarded. `s.accts[account].roots` is never written in the entire reseed path (confirmed: no write to `.roots` exists under beanstalk/init/), so the migrated account also has zero snapshot share until its first mow. This is a snapshot-checkpoint write bug: the historical weight being re-established at the migration boundary is corrupted, not preserved.
impact: Every farmer who migrated deposits in 2+ whitelisted tokens has their Stalk balance silently reduced to only the last token's contribution. Stalk is the basis for (a) earned-Bean distribution via roots, (b) Seed/grown-stalk accrual, and (c) any Stalk-weighted protocol decision. Affected farmers permanently lose the governance/reward weight of all but one of their deposit types at the L2 relaunch, while their underlying deposits remain. This is a direct, deterministic loss of a core protocol-state invariant (total Stalk == sum of account Stalk) at migration.

ite.intent: Migration must preserve each farmer's summed L1 Stalk as their L2 snapshot weight; instead multi-token holders lose all but one token's Stalk.
ite.technique: ReseedSilo.init() calls reseedSiloDeposit per token; line 164 assigns (=) rather than accumulates (+=) into s.accts[account].stalk, so each token's call clobbers the prior.
ite.evasion: No accumulation and no post-reseed sum-vs-global reconciliation; the require checks only validate per-token deposit totals, not the cross-token stalk sum.

ice_chain.consumer_action: uses account stalk as the baseline for earned-Bean entitlement and as Stalk-weighted reward/decision weight
